title: Product Experimentation and Customer Value Analytics
description: Two end-to-end analyses: an A/B test of a retention experiment (90,189 players) and cohort retention and customer lifetime value modelling (23,570 customers, BG/NBD and Gamma-Gamma) validated on a holdout. Metrics are defined in SQL (DuckDB), the analysis is in Python, and the models are checked against reference results by an automated test suite and a mutation check. Third-party datasets are documented in DATA_DICTIONARY.md and data/datapackage.json.
